note: Colorado Parks & Wildlife, on the US-50 bank of the Arkansas River between Swissvale and Howard. A takeout for boaters wanting a mellower float; some of the best fishing on the river is up and down from here. Highway road noise is the main drawback. --Claude
summary: CPW Salida-Vallie Bridge page + cpwshop park and 8 site pages: confirmed 8 sites, vault toilets, no potable water, year-round, reservable. Added hookups none, max 75 ft, pull-throughs, facilities note, booking url/window 180/fcfs never/booking season; season and booking now manual. Note: 'Reservable Apr-Oct, FCFS in winter' is contradicted (reservation only at all AHRA developed campgrounds; cpwshop peak season all year) and dropped, as are the 'Camp Colorado' booking line and the site/amenity restatements; 'boat launch' corrected to boater takeout.
flags: Waterfront riverfront CONFIRMED: cpwshop tags all 8 sites 'Riverfront'; on imagery the site points line the river edge 15-30 m from the water on an open gravel bench, with only a thin fringe of shrubs.
